Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: Validated inbound client project inquiry submitted via the Ravana Tech contact console or backend API.

name.description: Full name of the submitting client or organization.

email.description: Validated contact email address for follow-up.

system.description: Selected web engineering service or architecture category.

message.description: Detailed project requirements and launch timeline.

status.description: Workflow triage status enforced as 'new' on creation.

createdAt.description: Authoritative server timestamp assigned via request.time.

updatedAt.description: Optional authoritative server timestamp updated during admin triage.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Server-provisioned Ravana Tech administrator access record governing inquiry triage permissions.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching document ID.

role.description: Access role constrained strictly to admin.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Write-once client project inquiry records in database ravanatek-db. Public create is strictly schema-validated; reads and status updates are restricted to verified administrators; client deletes are denied.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Server-provisioned administrator registry in ravanatek-db. Users may read only their own record; all client-side writes are unconditionally denied.
